exposure: mode of delivery (cesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
outcome: survival rate at 24 hours, 1 week, 1 month, and 1 year
cohort: 123 fetuses diagnosed with trisomy 18 born at a single perinatal center between 1993 and 2009
finding: The study found high rates of prenatal complications, stillbirths, and neonatal deaths in fetuses with trisomy 18, with a median survival time of 3.5 days.
mod_finding: While there was no significant difference in overall survival time between cesarean and vaginal delivery, cesarean section was associated with significantly longer survival time in cases of breech presentation.
